kind: author-specified executable illustration; no model call, learned-policy claim, actual customer, actual payment, or physical sensor
artifact: a standalone Python program compiled from an authored affine measurement specification

technical_contract.predicate: exact weighted calibrated integer sum >= task threshold; fresh task binds exact schema and qualification

financial_model.unit: synthetic cost units; not dollars or observed labor/inference costs
financial_model.costs_due: Every route cost is prepaid. In the retained-constructor state, maintenance m is an unavoidable current-episode obligation paid before any route, including external service or nonentry. Nonentry is checked after preserving that obligation.
financial_model.objective: minimize full incremental cost among feasible routes, else nonentry
financial_model.capital: variable finite grid; not universal floor/ceiling; no external finance in this illustration
financial_model.rights_scope: current_internal consent controls internal routes; standard external route uses separate supplied standard terms
financial_model.equal_content_control: ordinary exact planner and ordinary interpreter receive same specifications, recipe, retained fixture, resources, cost schedule and action catalogue
financial_model.retention_break_even: Against fixture-only continuation, n*(44-33-m)-9 = n*(11-m)-9, for n fresh successors, common source construction cost54 and source receipt80; acquisition9 is paid after source collection, not counted twice.

comparisons: source artifact reuse on fresh schema
new standalone compilation and independent interpretation
claim_limits: semantic closure only over stated affine language and finite domain
constructor supplied by authors; no discovery or constructor learning measured
cost parameters selected for illustration; not fit to measured runtime
rights are scenario flags, not consent obtained
accepted means model predicate, not real buyer acceptance
freeze_rule: This protocol and all specs are written before the first generated-program run; preserve hash in results.
